metadata.title: Patient Safety Assurance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability ensuring cybersecurity controls actively preserve patient safety in clinical environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Clinical safety systems, medical device safety validation, and cyber‑physical assurance technologies.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for integrating cybersecurity controls with patient safety analysis and clinical risk management.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Cybersecurity mechanisms must reduce—not introduce—risk to patient safety and clinical outcomes.

metadata.remarks: Patient Safety Assurance defines how cybersecurity risks are identified, analyzed, and mitigated as clinical safety hazards. This pattern ensures that security controls are evaluated through the lens of patient harm prevention, safe degradation, and continuity of care. It establishes governance expectations and safety validation requirements rather than specific technical controls.

components.title: Safety Hazard Identification
components.description: Identification of cybersecurity‑induced hazards that may impact patient safety.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or corruption of data or device behavior leading to unsafe clinical outcomes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Systematic identification of cybersecurity risks as potential patient safety hazards.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cybersecurity risks are analyzed as potential patient safety hazards within clinical risk assessments.

components.title: Fail‑Safe and Safe‑State Controls
components.description: Design and validation of safe degradation or fail‑safe behavior during fault or attack conditions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Disruption or denial of safe operation through induced fault or unsafe state.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Engineering controls ensuring systems transition to safe states under abnormal conditions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Medical devices transition to defined safe states during abnormal, unsafe, or cyber‑induced conditions.

components.title: Safety Validation and Testing
components.description: Validation and testing to ensure cybersecurity controls do not negatively impact patient safety.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized modification or activation of controls that bypass safety validation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal testing and validation to confirm cybersecurity controls preserve clinical safety.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cybersecurity controls are validated and tested to confirm patient safety and clinical outcomes are preserved.
